title: Check their Venus sign, not their sun.
old_caption:
Do you know your partner's Venus sign?
Charts help, but asking "how do you like to be loved?" helps more.

title: Virgos aren't picky. They have standards.
old_caption:
Ever re-folded someone else's laundry because it was wrong?
Standards are good. So is letting the small things go. High standards, soft hands.

title: My bedtime, ruined by one good conversation
old_caption: 2 PM Taurus: in bed by 10, non-negotiable. 2 AM Taurus: on topic nine (best cloud), two snort-laughs and fake goodnight number six. Zero sleep, zero regrets. Who's worth staying up for?

title: My plan to play it cool
old_caption: 2 PM Aquarius: super chill, will reply in three business days. 2 AM Aquarius: read 'haha' 41 times and named the future dog. Turns out they were playing it cool too.

title: My confidence
old_caption: 2 PM Leo: I'm a catch, and the mirror agrees. 2 AM Leo: replaying an accidental 'you too!' and rating its own laugh 4 out of 10. Pisces, sobbing, says yes. What does 2 AM tell you?

title: My belief in love
old_caption: 2 PM Capricorn: romance is not in the budget, I have meetings. 2 AM Capricorn: draft eleven of an ode to your laugh, rhyming moon with soon. Ever written something your daytime self would never see?

title: The text I drafted
old_caption: 2 PM Cancer drafted 'hey.' 2 AM Cancer wrote a director's cut covering the weather, our future, and signed 'no pressure :)'. Morning Cancer sent two kind lines instead. Ever been saved by sleeping on it?

title: A blind mystery card's day
old_caption: A blind card wakes at 7, gets shuffled on the commute, survives a near-skip at 9:14 and clocks out loved. Honestly a better work week than mine. Would you have flipped it?

title: The moon on date night
old_caption: A day in the life of the moon on date night: clock in, hover (sorry, orbit), dim the other stars, and definitely not eavesdrop. Overtime gladly. Has the moon ever helped you out?

title: A phone waiting for a text back
old_caption: Shift report from a phone waiting for a text back: six checks in two minutes, three false alarms (battery, plant reminder, mom), then the right buzz. Who checked their phone just now?
